name: tests-half-hcloud-go-opaque-schema-extension-preservation
instr:
Preserve opaque JSON members in Certificate, Network, LoadBalancerType and LoadBalancer schema JSON round trips. Certificate, Network and LoadBalancerType public/schema conversions retain root extensions; LoadBalancer conversions retain service/HTTP extensions with their respective siblings. Retain Certificate id/name/domain_names/used_by, Network id/ip_range/labels and subnet/route counts, LoadBalancer id/name, and LoadBalancerType max_connections/max_services/deprecated alongside extensions. Certificate and Network conversions produce independently mutable extension collections; identically named Certificate and LoadBalancerType extensions remain independent.

ExtensionFields accepts object, scalar, array and null JSON and returns supplied bytes exactly. Constructor inputs and Get results cannot mutate stored bytes. Clone has an independent map. Reject empty names and malformed JSON; rejected collection updates preserve stored members, and rejected Certificate updates retain earlier valid values. Invalid-value ExtensionError has Name and nonempty Reason, both included in Error(); collection and Network error messages agree. Certificate and Network name-conflict errors agree.

LoadBalancerClient.Create sends one request containing extensions at root, algorithm, service, HTTP, health-check and health-check HTTP boundaries beside declared fields. Later source-byte mutation does not change root extension JSON. Malformed root Extensions fail with *ExtensionError before transport
